newsitem.title: FRANCE: Socialists would block France Telecom sale - Juppe.
newsitem.headline: Socialists would block France Telecom sale - Juppe.

text.p: Prime Minister Alain Juppe said on Thursday that a Socialist victory in a snap parliamentary election would damage French competitivity by blocking the partial sale of state-owned France Telecom.
"What would happen if the opposition should win? France Telecom would be renationalised, or rather 'restate-ified'," Juppe said at a campaign rally.
"That means we would be knocked out of world competition. This would be a terrible setback for French technology."
He also forecast that France Telecom would have to reverse recent reductions in telephone rates.

French President Jacques Chirac this week dissolved parliament and set a parliamentary election for May 25 and June 1. The government later announced the sale of a stake in France Telecom would go on as planned, but would be delayed four weeks until June 6, after the election was over.
Socialist Party leader Lionel Jospin has said he would not allow the partial privatisation of France Telecom to go forward should the opposition win the election.
